items.item_text: resume

Must possess valid California Driver's License to drive a County or University vehicle. Ability and means to travel on a flexible schedule as needed, proof of liability damage insurance on vehicle used is required. Reimbursement of job-related travel will be reimbursed according to University policies.
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.

Under the general direction of the Lead Digital Communication Strategist provides content strategy consultation, coordinates website and content projects, and supports the ongoing development and maintenance of UC ANR's Integrated Web Platform (IWP). Applies content strategy principles, accessibility standards, information architecture, and established organizational best practices to improve digital experiences across a variety of websites. Independently manages multiple concurrent projects, balances competing priorities, and exercises sound judgment in coordinating stakeholder needs and delivering timely, user-centered digital solutions. Works collaboratively with senior Content Team members to implement organizational priorities while escalating highly complex or strategic issues for guidance when appropriate.
Website Consulting, Content Strategy & Project Coordination
This position is a career appointment that is 100% fixed.

Provide content strategy consultation to website owners and stakeholders regarding website planning, content organization, navigation, and information architecture Coordinate website and content projects from intake through implementation, ensuring timely completion and alignment with established project goals and organizational standards Independently manage multiple concurrent website and content projects while balancing competing priorities and responding to high-priority and time-sensitive requests, especially those from leadership Consult with stakeholders to gather requirements, identify content needs, and recommend effective website and content solutions Apply established content strategy principles, accessibility standards, governance, and web best practices across IWP Review website content for accessibility, readability, usability, and alignment with established organizational standards Recommend practical content improvements informed by accessibility reviews, stakeholder feedback, website analytics, and user experience principles Support planning for new websites, significant redesigns, and major content updates Assist website owners in planning, maintaining, and continuously improving website content throughout its lifecycle Exercise sound judgment in managing stakeholder expectations and escalate highly complex, cross-organizational, or strategic issues to senior Content Team members when appropriate.

This position may be eligible for a hybrid work arrangement, combining remote work with on-site work at the designated office in Davis, CA. Candidates must be available to work on-site at least two days per week, with additional on-site work and travel as business needs require.
Website Support & Training
Pay Scale: $75,900.00/year to $106,600.00/year

Provide ongoing consultation and support for IWP website administrators Respond to website content questions and provide guidance on content strategy, accessibility, information architecture, and web best practices Assist website administrators with implementing recommended content improvements within the IWP Develop, maintain, and continuously improve website guidance, documentation, templates, and training materials Deliver one-on-one consultations, workshops, office hours, and group training sessions for website administrators Support implementation of established content governance, digital standards, and accessibility requirements across UC ANR websites Assist with website content reviews, accessibility remediation efforts, and digital improvement initiatives Collaborate with the Accessibility Team and other partners to promote accessible, user centered digital content.
This job is open until filled. The first application review date will be 10/30/2026.
Continuous Improvement & Collaboration

Use website analytics, accessibility reviews, stakeholder feedback, and content assessments to identify opportunities for continuous improvement Research and maintain knowledge of emerging trends and best practices related to content strategy, accessibility, content management systems, artificial intelligence, and web communications Collaborate with Information Technology, Strategic Communications, the Accessibility Team, and other cross-functional partners on digital initiatives Contribute to improvements in Content Team workflows, documentation, templates, and service delivery Participate in planning and implementation of Content Team and organizational digital initiatives that support UC ANR's IWP.
Thorough knowledge & proven experience applying content strategy principles to develop and improve website content, information architecture, and web writing using digital best practices.
Thorough knowledge & extensive experience utilizing enterprise web publishing platforms and content management systems.
Demonstrated expertise in applying WCAG accessibility standards, digital content governance, and usability principles to ensure inclusive user experiences.
Experience applying user experience (UX) principles to the design and organization of digital content and site structures.
A track record of successful consultation and facilitation, with the ability to build effective working relationships across a diverse, multi-departmental organization.
Proven ability to independently prioritize and manage multiple concurrent digital projects while adapting to shifting priorities and deadlines.
Ability to analyze website content and recommend practical, user-centered improvements using established standards, analytics, and stakeholder feedback.
Experience analyzing website performance using analytics and stakeholder feedback to recommend and implement user-centered improvements.
Experience developing documentation, guidance, templates, and training materials.
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical and content concepts to audiences with varying levels of digital expertise.
Demonstrated sound judgment, initiative, and problem-solving skills when managing moderately complex assignments.
Experience working with content management systems (CMS), preferably Drupal.
Prior experience working within the University of California system, higher education, or another large, decentralized organization.
Experience supporting website accessibility, content strategy, and content governance initiatives.
Special Conditions of Employment:

As of January 1, 2014, ANR is a smoke- and tobacco-free environment in which smoking, the use of smokeless tobacco products, and the use of unregulated nicotine products (e-cigarettes), is strictly prohibited.

“Misconduct” means any violation of the policies governing employee conduct at the applicant’s previous place of employment, including, but not limited to, violations of policies prohibiting sexual harassment, sexual assault, or other forms of harassment, or discrimination, as defined by the employer. For reference, below are UC’s policies addressing some forms of misconduct:
UC Sexual Violence and Sexual Harassment Policy
UC Anti-Discrimination Policy
Abusive Conduct in the Workplace
It is the policy of the University of California to undertake affirmative action and anti-discrimination efforts, consistent with its obligations as a Federal and State contractor.

The University reserves the right to make employment contingent upon successful completion of the background check. This is a designated position requiring a background check and may require fingerprinting due to the nature of the job responsibilities. UC ANR does hire people with conviction histories and reviews information received in the context of the job responsibilities.

As a condition of employment, you will be required to comply with the University of California Policy on Vaccination Programs, as may be amended or revised from time to time.  Federal, state, or local public health directives may impose additional requirements.

Misconduct Disclosure Requirement: As a condition of employment, the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
